mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_knowledge_library WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY usage_count DESC
SELECT id, name, description, icon, category, document_count, status FROM ai_knowledge_library WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY usage_count DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_library SET document_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_knowledge_base WHERE library_id = #{libraryId} AND status = 2), total_segments = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(segment_count), 0) FROM ai_knowledge_base WHERE library_id = #{libraryId} AND status = 2), total_size = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM ai_knowledge_base WHERE library_id = #{libraryId}), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{libraryId}
UPDATE ai_knowledge_library SET usage_count = usage_count + 1, last_used_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{libraryId}
UPDATE ai_knowledge_library SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{libraryId}
